decisions.reason: An encrypted secondary channel is a core building block of the firm's security platform and costs little to keep offering.
Mobile PDF signing meets growing eIDAS-driven demand in German banking and insurance and complements the firm's other products.
The multi-layer end-to-end security architecture is the firm's foundational offering on which the other products depend.
The email-to-app delivery robot is a niche add-on, but it supports secure customer communication and shows no sign yet of warranting removal.
Demand for hardware QR tokens may weaken as app-based PSD2 authentication spreads, but after only one year in the market the firm would likely keep it for existing bank clients.
Payment network compliance requirements such as PCI and PSD2 keep demand stable among financial clients.
